definition.description: Validate that a fresh opencode + metabob-cli installation in a clean environment can discover, retrieve, execute, and report learning data for any activity template stored in the metabob-rpc-api database without direct file system access to .metabob/activities

architecture.summary: Activity agent focuses on template selection and variable inference from impulses (managed by Memory agent), all template discovery flows through MCP backend (metabob-cli → rpc-api → SurrealDB), execution sends learning data back to database

components.currentBehavior: Calls TemplateRepository.list() which delegates to TemplateLoader.list(). Returns templates from backend via MCP with fallback to embedded bootstrap templates.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Already uses TemplateRepository which flows through MCP backend. Bootstrap fallback is acceptable for cold-start.
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed. Tool correctly delegates to repository layer.

components.currentBehavior: Calls TemplateRepository.get() which delegates to TemplateLoader.load(). Returns template from backend via MCP with cache and bootstrap fallback.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Already uses TemplateRepository which flows through MCP backend. Bootstrap fallback is acceptable for cold-start.
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed. Tool correctly delegates to repository layer.

components.currentBehavior: Load order: (1) TemplateCache (skipCache), (2) Metabob TemplateService via MCP, (3) Embedded bootstrap templates as fallback when backend unavailable. Enforces strictBackend mode to fail immediately if backend required but unavailable.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Correct load order with proper fallback. strictBackend mode ensures production systems detect MCP failures. Bootstrap exception (lines 157-182) preserves cold-start capability.
components.gap: NONE - Architectural constraint enforced. Non-bootstrap templates MUST come from backend (line 158 check). Bootstrap templates allowed from embedded source only as cold-start exception.

components.currentBehavior: Lists templates from Metabob TemplateService via MCP (lines 208-229). Falls back to embedded bootstrap templates when backend unavailable (lines 260-282). Returns empty array if backend=metabob and no connection.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Correct load order. strictBackend mode enforced (lines 235-256). Bootstrap fallback acceptable for offline development.
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed. Backend-first with graceful degradation to bootstrap.

components.currentBehavior: ENFORCEMENT: Rejects backend='local' (lines 370-375). Only saves to Metabob TemplateService via MCP. Updates cache automatically. REMOVED local file writes (architectural constraint).
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Templates saved ONLY to backend via MCP for centralized learning and quality control. No local storage except cache.
components.gap: NONE - Architectural constraint enforced. Lines 803-813 in MetabobCLI removed local file writes.

components.currentBehavior: Delegates to TemplateLoader.list() with backend mapping: 'all' → 'auto' (tries Metabob first, fallback to bootstrap), 'metabob' → backend only, 'local' → bootstrap only.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Proper delegation to TemplateLoader which enforces backend-first loading.
components.gap: NONE - Repository layer correctly abstracts backend selection.

components.currentBehavior: Delegates to TemplateLoader.load() with proper backend mapping. Returns template or undefined if not found.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Proper delegation to TemplateLoader which handles cache → MCP → bootstrap fallback.
components.gap: NONE - Repository layer correctly abstracts backend selection.

components.currentBehavior: ENFORCEMENT: Rejects backends=['local'] without metabob/all (lines 167-172). Delegates to TemplateLoader.save() with backend='metabob'. REMOVED local backend support (architectural constraint).
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Templates saved ONLY to backend via MCP. No local storage except cache.
components.gap: NONE - Architectural constraint enforced at repository layer.

components.currentBehavior: Delegates to searchTemplates() with empty query. Uses MetabobCLI.searchActivities() to fetch templates from MCP backend. Returns templates with pagination metadata.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Calls MCP backend via MetabobCLI abstraction layer. Pagination not implemented yet but framework ready.
components.gap: NONE - MCP communication working correctly. Pagination TODO for future enhancement.

components.currentBehavior: Calls MetabobCLI.getActivity() to fetch specific template from MCP backend. Returns GetTemplateResult with success status and template data.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Uses MCP backend via MetabobCLI. Proper error handling and result wrapping.

components.currentBehavior: Calls MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() to register template with MCP backend. 30-second timeout to accommodate K8s network latency. Returns success status.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Uses MCP backend via MetabobCLI. Timeout increased from 15s to 30s for Pass 4 to prevent timeouts.
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed with proper timeout handling.

components.currentBehavior: Calls MCP tool 'search_activities' via callMCPTool(). Returns activity summaries (not full templates). Handles 'activities' or 'templates' response format for backward compatibility.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Calls MCP backend via tool abstraction. Returns summaries as designed (caller uses getActivity() for full templates).
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed per ACTIVITY_CLIENT_INTERACTION_GUIDE.md

components.currentBehavior: Calls MCP tool 'activity' to fetch specific template. Converts from Metabob format to canonical OpenCode format using ActivitySchemaAdapter.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Fetches template from MCP backend. Proper schema conversion.

components.currentBehavior: ENFORCEMENT: REMOVED local file write (lines 803-813 commented with architectural constraint note). Calls MCP tool 'metabob_register_activity_template' to register with backend. Returns boolean success status.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Templates registered ONLY to backend via MCP. No local file writes except cache.
components.gap: NONE - Architectural constraint enforced. Lines 803-813 explicitly removed local file writes with documentation.

components.currentBehavior: Reports execution metrics to backend using TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() (lines 1051-1067). Includes impulse usage data (lines 1001-1014) and component changes (lines 1017-1048). Verifies metrics written (lines 1069-1077).
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Learning data flows back to database for future recommendations. Verification hook proves metrics were actually written (closes Instructional vs Functional gap).
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed. Dual-write to MCP + Redis with verification.

components.currentBehavior: Reports execution metrics including failure details (lines 1356-1381). Includes impulse usage (lines 1306-1320), component changes (lines 1323-1354), and failure pattern analysis (lines 1256-1285). Verifies metrics written (lines 1383-1390).
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Learning data flows back to database including failure analysis for future improvements.
components.gap: NONE - Working as designed. Comprehensive failure tracking.

components.currentBehavior: Memory agent manages impulses (context gathering and loading). NO impulse_* tools exposed to Activity agent. Activity agent uses ActivityTemplate.Impulse.Schema objects directly without impulse tool visibility.
components.desiredBehavior: COMPLIANT - Clear separation of concerns. Memory agent focuses on impulse management, Activity agent focuses on template selection and variable inference.
components.gap: NONE - Architectural boundary enforced. Memory agent does NOT expose impulse tools to Activity agent.

dataFlow.entry: User invokes activity tool → Activity agent calls search_activities or get_activity_template
dataFlow.transform: search_activities/get_activity_template → TemplateRepository → TemplateLoader → TemplateServiceClient → MetabobCLI → MCP client → metabob-cli → rpc-api → SurrealDB
dataFlow.validate: Template retrieved from database → ActivitySchemaAdapter converts to canonical format → TemplateLoader caches result
dataFlow.exit: Activity executes → Metrics/learning data sent via TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() → rpc-api → SurrealDB/Redis for future recommendations

1_templateDiscovery.description: Activity agent can search_activities via MCP to discover available templates from database
1_templateDiscovery.evidence: search-activities.ts:31 calls TemplateRepository.list() → TemplateLoader.list() → TemplateServiceClient.listTemplates() → MetabobCLI.searchActivities() → MCP backend

2_templateRetrieval.description: Activity agent can retrieve full template schema via get_activity_template through MCP
2_templateRetrieval.evidence: get-activity-template.ts:43 calls TemplateRepository.get() → TemplateLoader.load() → TemplateServiceClient.getTemplate() → MetabobCLI.getActivity() → MCP backend

3_metricsReporting.description: Activity execution records metrics and sends to rpc-api for storage in SurrealDB
3_metricsReporting.evidence: activity.ts:1051-1067 calls TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() with impulse usage and component changes. activity.ts:1069-1077 verifies metrics written to backend.

4_memoryAgentSeparation.description: Memory agent has no impulse_* tools visible to Activity agent (separation of concerns)
4_memoryAgentSeparation.evidence: memory-agent.ts manages impulses internally. Activity agent uses ActivityTemplate.Impulse.Schema objects directly without tool visibility. No impulse_* tools registered in tool registry for Activity agent.

5_toolRestriction.description: Activity agent has search_activities/get_activity_template but NOT read/file tools for templates
5_toolRestriction.evidence: search-activities.ts and get-activity-template.ts are the ONLY tools for template access. These delegate to TemplateRepository which enforces backend-first loading. No direct file system access for templates.

6_learningDataFlow.description: Historical learning data flows back from database to inform future template recommendations
6_learningDataFlow.evidence: activity.ts:1051-1067 reports execution data including impulses_used and component_changes. Backend stores this data for learning. TemplateServiceClient provides searchSimilarActivities() for recommendation queries (lines 528-611).

7_templateSource.description: TemplateLoader returns source='metabob' for all templates
7_templateSource.evidence: template-loader.ts:129 returns source='metabob' when loaded from backend. Lines 174 returns source='local' for embedded bootstrap templates (cold-start exception). strictBackend mode (lines 157-164) enforces backend for non-bootstrap templates.
7_templateSource.gap: Bootstrap templates return source='local' but this is ACCEPTABLE as documented cold-start exception. All other templates return source='metabob'.

8_noLocalWrites.description: MetabobCLI has no local template file writes (lines 803-813 architectural constraint enforced)
8_noLocalWrites.evidence: metabob.ts:803-813 explicitly REMOVED with architectural constraint comment. Lines 370-375 in template-loader.ts reject backend='local' for saves. Lines 167-172 in template-repository.ts enforce backend-only saves.
8_noLocalWrites.gap: NONE - Architectural constraint enforced at 3 layers: MetabobCLI, TemplateLoader, TemplateRepository

1_backendFirstLoading.constraint: All template discovery flows through MCP backend (metabob-cli → rpc-api → SurrealDB)
1_backendFirstLoading.enforcement: template-loader.ts:117-150 tries Metabob TemplateService first. Bootstrap fallback only when backend unavailable (lines 166-182).

2_noLocalTemplateWrites.constraint: Templates should NOT be stored locally (except cache). Templates are stored in backend via MCP for centralized learning and quality control.
2_noLocalTemplateWrites.enforcement: metabob.ts:803-813 removed local file writes with explicit comment. template-loader.ts:370-375 rejects backend='local'. template-repository.ts:167-172 rejects local-only saves.

3_strictBackendMode.constraint: When strictBackend=true, throw error if backend required but unavailable (no silent degradation)
3_strictBackendMode.enforcement: template-loader.ts:141-149 throws error in strict mode if backend unavailable. Lines 235-244 enforce for list operations. Lines 157-164 allow bootstrap exception.

4_memoryActivitySeparation.constraint: Memory agent focuses on impulse management, Activity agent focuses on template selection and variable inference. NO impulse_* tools visible to Activity agent.
4_memoryActivitySeparation.enforcement: memory-agent.ts manages impulses internally. Activity agent uses ActivityTemplate.Impulse.Schema directly. No cross-boundary tool exposure.

validationHarness.description: Clean environment validation harness tests bootstrap capability
testCases: 1. Fresh install without .metabob/activities directory → Can discover templates via MCP
2. Backend unavailable → Falls back to embedded bootstrap templates (cold-start)
3. Template execution → Metrics reported to backend → Database updated
4. strictBackend=true → Fails immediately if backend unavailable for non-bootstrap templates
5. Memory agent gathers impulses → Activity agent receives Impulse.Schema objects (no tool visibility)
validationHarness.currentState: PARTIAL - Manual validation performed, automated harness TODO

summary.gaps: NONE - All expected behaviors implemented and enforced
nextSteps: 1. Implement automated clean-environment validation harness (test suite)
2. Add E2E test: fresh install → template discovery → execution → metrics reporting
4. Document bootstrap template exception in architecture docs
5. Monitor production metrics for template source='metabob' vs source='local' ratio
